questions.prompt: When should the current subset be added to the answers?

choices.label: Only when it contains every input value.
choices.feedback: Every partial selection is itself a valid subset, including the empty selection.

choices.label: Only when it contains exactly one value.
choices.feedback: Every partial selection is itself a valid subset, including the empty selection.

choices.label: At every recursive call, including the initial empty subset.
choices.feedback: Every partial selection is itself a valid subset, including the empty selection.

questions.prompt: Which positions may be chosen next after an index has been chosen?

choices.label: Only the immediately next position.
choices.feedback: Increasing indices give each subset one construction order and prevent reusing a position.

choices.label: Only later input positions.
choices.feedback: Increasing indices give each subset one construction order and prevent reusing a position.

choices.label: Any position, including ones already chosen.
choices.feedback: Increasing indices give each subset one construction order and prevent reusing a position.

questions.prompt: What should happen after returning from a branch that appended a value?

choices.label: Remove that value before trying the next choice.
choices.feedback: Undoing the most recent choice restores the parent subset so sibling branches start from the same selection.

choices.label: Leave that value in place for every later branch.
choices.feedback: Undoing the most recent choice restores the parent subset so sibling branches start from the same selection.

choices.label: Clear the entire result list.
